title: Bug: Dispatched tasks via autopilot don't respect "repo" description comment
description:
Currently when autopilot dispatches, it uses the default repo. Where we override the default via "repo=" in a project description, this isn't carried by the dispatched prompts, causing them to run in the wrong folder.

Dispatched prompts should inherit the autopilot's folder/repo.

comments.body:
## Investigation — root cause found (isolated)

**Root cause:** the fused autopilot verb `POST /api/proxy/recommend-and-dispatch` discards the server-resolved repo. At `routes/proxy.js:3923` the dispatched item is built with `repo: repo || null`, where `repo` is **only** the caller-supplied `req.body.repo` (destructured at `routes/proxy.js:3792`). The recommendation object `rec` already carries the correct repo — `computeRecommendation` sets `repo: parseRepoFromDescription(project?.description)` for the *terminal* node (`routes/proxy.js:2796`) — but `rec.repo` is never read on the dispatch path. So when autopilot fires this verb without an explicit `repo` (the normal case — the whole point of the fused verb is that the server resolves prompt + context), the queued item gets `repo: null` and the worker falls back to the default repo, ignoring the `repo=` line in the project description.

Contrast `GET /api/proxy/recommend`, which correctly surfaces the resolved repo (`repo: rec.repo`, `routes/proxy.js:2921`). The fused verb is the only seam that resolves repo server-side and then drops it.

**Smallest viable fix:** at `routes/proxy.js:3923`, change
```js
repo: repo || null
```
to
```js
repo: repo || rec.repo || null
```
This preserves an explicit caller override (constraint: keep the `repo=` override winning) while inheriting the recommendation's resolved repo when the caller omits it. Because the dispatched item references the *terminal* node (`rec.identifier`), `rec.repo` is the terminal node's project repo — the correct working directory after any defer descent.

**Isolated vs class:** Isolated to the fused verb. The two-step paths are correct/by-design:
- `POST /api/proxy/dispatch` (`routes/proxy.js:3754`) and the user-facing `routes/dispatch.js:288` take a caller-supplied prompt, so the caller is responsible for forwarding `repo` (it got it from `GET /recommend`). There is no server-side `rec` to inherit from in those flows.
- `GET /recommend` already returns `rec.repo` correctly.

The underlying *pattern* worth a one-line guard in review: "a fused/server-side verb must propagate every functional context field it resolves (repo = working directory), not just the display header fields." In this verb `issueId/issueTitle/issueUrl` are intentionally nulled (header-only response), but `repo` is functional context and must not be.

**Staleness check:** `routes/proxy.js`, `lib/prompt-formatters.js`, `lib/dispatch-store.js` are unchanged since this ticket was created (2026-06-17); only `routes/dispatch.js` changed (LIN-357, `blocked`-label removal — unrelated to repo). Ticket description holds at HEAD `386e330`.

_No code shipped — investigation only; leaving the `bug` label in place._
